summary: Candidate template for a single-location, six-view asset sheet. The header carries the same metadata columns. The main area has one large HERO/ESTABLISHING view, two top-right DETAIL panels, two SUPPORT VIEW panels (REVERSE VIEW and APPROACH VIEW), a bottom-left PROP/SIGNAGE panel, an INTERACTION_ZONE panel, and a LOCATION NOTES / DO NOT USE FOR footer.

composition: Landscape template with dark green border and cream/white field.
Header reads 'ASSET SHEET' with TITLE, TYPE, STATUS, VERSION, SOURCE/QA columns.
Metadata: TITLE 'Single Location 6 View', TYPE 'Environment / location deep sheet', STATUS 'candidate', VERSION 'v1', SOURCE/QA 'GPT-authored template'.
Top-right: two DETAIL panels 'DETAIL A' and 'DETAIL B'.
Middle-right: two SUPPORT_VIEW panels 'REVERSE VIEW' and 'APPROACH VIEW'.
Bottom-left: PROP_DETAIL 'PROP / SIGNAGE' and INTERACTION_ZONE 'INTERACTION ZONE'.
Bottom-right 'LOCATION NOTES / DO NOT USE FOR' block.
guidance_notes: Use for a richly documented single location.
A deeper alternative to the 3-view template when a location needs multiple detail surfaces, props, signage, approach/reverse views, and interaction zones.
Do not use for four separate trials or independent locations.

positive_constraints: Use this template for richly documented single-location deep sheets.
Keep the six panels in the prescribed layout when populating the template.
Reserve the hero for establishing, the detail/support panels for surfaces, and the bottom panels for prop/signage and interaction zones.
negative_constraints: Do not use this template for four separate trials or independent locations.
Do not treat 'candidate' status as final accepted canon.
Do not add extra views beyond the six prescribed.

best_for: Planning detailed single-location environment reference sheets.
QA of asset sheets built from this template.
not_sufficient_for: Final canon approval without sheet content and image QA.
